_comment: Ratchet for scripts/ci/raw-status-leak-guard.mjs (UX-003). maxViolations is the live count measured on the fix/ux-003 branch after fixing procurement/planning/new, hr/payroll/CreatePayrollRunForm, citizen/grievances/new, and procurement/indents/new/CreateIndentForm (down from 172 pre-fix). It must only ever move DOWN, in the same PR that fixes the corresponding files — see follow-up gap UX-016 in docs/ENTERPRISE-GAP-REPORT-2026-09-07.md for the tracked remainder. UX-016 tranche 1 (fix/ux-016) fixed the entire works/ module (17 violations across 10 files: works/_data/client.ts, works/approvals/ApprovalFinalizeButton.tsx, works/billing/[workId]/BillingActions.tsx, works/billing/account-compile/page.tsx, works/contractors/[id]/ContractorEditToggle.tsx, works/execution/[workId]/ExecutionActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalEditToggle.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalExtActions.tsx, works/tenders/[id]/TenderActions.tsx), lowering the count from 169 to 152. 152 remain across the other modules — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before starting the next tranche. UX-020 EXCEPTION to 'only ever moves down': 152 -> 261 on fix/ux-020 is a detection-strength jump, not a regression or a bulk-unfix — independent review of UX-016's own 'done' works/ module found 6 real leaks the pre-UX-020 regex structurally could not see (un-parenthesized `${res.status}` template interpolation, `String(res.status)`, and hardcoded '<Verb> failed' fallbacks other than the one literal 'Request failed' phrase the guard checked for). Strengthening the regex to close those holes (see raw-status-leak-guard.mjs's doc comment) made 109 more pre-existing, already-live violations visible fleet-wide (152 -> 261) without a single new leak landing — confirmed by diffing the file:line list before/after the regex change, not just the count. UX-020's OTHER fix (browserClient.ts's errorMessageFromResponse, see the gap report) incidentally fixed its own `API_ERROR: ${res.status}` fallback as part of routing through toHumanError, which happened to also be one of the 261 the strengthened regex could now see (apps/web/src/lib/api/browserClient.ts:56) — a real, verified fix, so 261 -> 260 the normal way this ratchet always moves down: re-ran the guard after the browserClient.ts change and confirmed the count dropped by exactly that one file:line, nothing else. 260 remain (259 from the detection-jump set, un-fixed; UX-020 does not fix the 6 named works/ sites either — proving detection was the DoD, see the gap report). UX-024 (filed, still Open) separately found the 260 checked-in here was ALREADY 1 low vs the live count (261) at that same commit — one pre-existing, unrelated leak in apps/web/src/lib/crm/documents.ts:271 dating to PR #463, outside both UX-016's and UX-020's scope; tracked and fixed independently, not folded in here. UX-016 tranche 2 (fix/ux-016-tranche2) fixed the entire hr/ module — the single largest concentration per a fresh guard run (50 of the then-live 261 violations across 39 files: hr/_components/{OvertimeClaimForm,WFHRequestForm}.tsx, hr/advances/RequestAdvanceForm.tsx, hr/apar/new/page.tsx, hr/appraisals/new/NewAppraisalForm.tsx, hr/attendance/regularisation/RegularisationTable.tsx, hr/confirmation/_components/ProbationConfirmationCard.tsx, hr/dashboard/_components/ActionInbox.tsx, hr/departments/DepartmentsTable.tsx, hr/departments/new/AddDepartmentForm.tsx, hr/designations/DesignationsTable.tsx, hr/designations/new/AddDesignationForm.tsx, hr/employees/[id]/edit/EditEmployeeForm.tsx, hr/employees/import/ImportForm.tsx, hr/employees/new/AddEmployeeWizard.tsx, hr/holidays/AddHolidayForm.tsx, hr/leave-policies/{CreateLeavePolicyForm.tsx,page.tsx}, hr/leave/allocate/AllocateLeaveForm.tsx, hr/leave/apply/ApplyLeaveForm.tsx, hr/leave/approvals/LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx, hr/leave/history/page.tsx, hr/locations/new/AddLocationForm.tsx, hr/overtime/new/page.tsx, hr/payroll/[id]/PayrollRunActions.tsx, hr/payroll/disbursement/{BankFileForm,BankFileWizard,DscConfigForm,NachMandateForm}.tsx, hr/payroll/pensioners/new/CreatePensionerForm.tsx, hr/payroll/returns/{ForceFileButton.tsx,page.tsx}, hr/payroll/tax-declaration/TaxDeclarationForm.tsx, hr/recruitment/[id]/{page.tsx,applications/[appId]/page.tsx}, hr/recruitment/new/NewJobOpeningForm.tsx, hr/training/new/NewTrainingForm.tsx, hr/transfer/_components/TransferOrderCard.tsx, hr/travel/TravelRequestForm.tsx), each routed through useFormError's fromResponse/fromException (server components hr/payroll/returns/page.tsx used the non-hook toHumanError building block directly, same as works/_data/client.ts in tranche 1) with inline fieldError(...) spans added on every addressable field. Guard confirms 0 remaining under hr/; live count 261 -> 211 (exact match, strict reduction; the pre-existing UX-024 documents.ts drift is untouched and still embedded in 211, tracked separately). 211 violations remain across ~29 other modules — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before the next tranche. UX-024 (fix/ux-024) fixed the pre-existing, unrelated documents.ts:271 leak named above (dating to PR #463, never part of UX-016's or UX-020's own scope) by routing uploadToStorage's S3-PUT failure through the same errorMessageFromResponse(res) bare call this file's own presignUpload/confirmDocument already use -- errorMessageFromResponse never reads the response body, it only branches on res.status internally to pick a toHumanError kind, so it is safe to reuse even though this one response comes from the storage provider, not our API. Guard count 211 -> 210 (exact match, strict reduction). See docs/ENTERPRISE-GAP-REPORT-2026-09-07.md UX-024 for the separate CI-timing investigation into how this single-violation baseline drift went undetected between PR #463 (2026-08-05) and this fix. UX-016 tranche 3 (fix/ux-016-tranche3) fixed the entire admin/ module — the single largest concentration per a fresh guard run (29 of the then-live 210 violations across 11 files: admin/config/page.tsx, admin/feature-flags/FeatureFlagsManager.tsx, admin/gateway-config/page.tsx, admin/integrations/_components/IntegrationDrawer.tsx, admin/integrations/page.tsx, admin/org/OrgHierarchyManager.tsx, admin/role-features/RoleFeaturesManager.tsx, admin/roles/RolesPermissionsManager.tsx, admin/scheduled-jobs/ScheduledJobsManager.tsx, admin/settings/page.tsx, admin/users/AdminUsersManager.tsx), each routed through useFormError's fromResponse/fromException with inline fieldError(...) spans added on every addressable field. Eight of these files (feature-flags/FeatureFlagsManager.tsx, gateway-config/page.tsx, integrations/page.tsx, org/OrgHierarchyManager.tsx, role-features/RoleFeaturesManager.tsx, roles/RolesPermissionsManager.tsx, scheduled-jobs/ScheduledJobsManager.tsx, users/AdminUsersManager.tsx) had a module-scope, non-component API helper (callApi / fetchRolePermissions+saveRolePermissions) that can't call the useFormError hook, so those route through the same non-hook toHumanError building block works/_data/client.ts used in tranche 1 instead; gateway-config/page.tsx's fetchConfig and integrations/page.tsx's load are useCallback'd with an intentionally empty/fixed deps array (formError.fromResponse/fromException are individually stable via useFormError's own internal useCallback, but the wrapping formError object literal is not, so adding it to deps would re-create the callback — and re-run its effect — every render; see the inline comment at each site, first established in hr/leave/approvals/LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx during tranche 2). Two existing tests (org/OrgHierarchyManager.test.tsx, roles/RolesPermissionsManager.test.tsx) had asserted the OLD leaky behavior itself — the raw backend message or HTTP status appearing verbatim in the alert — and were updated to assert the new clerk-safe catalogued copy instead, the same way tranche 2's own new tests do; one new test was added to integrations/_components/IntegrationDrawer.test.tsx covering the Propose-change failure path, which had no error-path coverage before. Guard confirms 0 remaining under admin/; live count 210 -> 181 (exact match, strict reduction). 181 violations remain across 38 other modules (finance/ is next-largest at 21 across 11 files) — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before the next tranche.
